item.title: Did Apple Search engine bot enter the security LLM fuzzing gauntlet
item.summary: Just noticed in the last 4 weeks that this user-agent string has gone crazy on the sites I support. 20 million requests in the last 4 weeks or about 500k a day and alot of it looks to try and 'hack'...... user-agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Applebot-Extended/0.1; +http://www.apple.com/go/applebot) i.e. /key.pem /nginx_status /.hermes/config.yaml etc Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49241439 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
